title: Breakaway civilization built on crash-retrieval secrecy

tellings.quote: this? And I thought, well, they're really actually kind of like a separate civilization, one that's broken away from our our own.

plain: A UFO historian named Richard Dolan says that since 1947, the secret world inside the United States that is said to hold crashed craft not made by humans has grown so cut off that it is like a separate civilization, one that has broken away from our own. He borrows the idea from the writings of the historian Arnold Toynbee. If true, it would mean a hidden part of society with its own knowledge and power now runs alongside the public one.
